description: A standalone workout timer sub-app for core exercises, following the same architecture as the existing kettlebell-timer sub-app. Workouts are structured hierarchically as phases, each with one or more sets of exercises and configurable inter-set rest. Each exercise has its own work and rest durations. The timer displays the exercise name, a set label ('Set 2 of 3'), and a countdown. Audio beeps alert the user at 10 seconds remaining and during the final 5 seconds of each block.

tickets.title: Create workout data structure
tickets.description: Create the workouts definition file for the core timer sub-app. This introduces a new hierarchical data model: a workout contains phases, each phase has a name, a number of sets, a restBetweenSets duration (seconds), and an exercises array. Each exercise has a name, work duration (seconds), and rest duration (seconds). One placeholder workout must be created so the rest of the sub-app can be wired up; the user will add real workouts later.
acceptance_criteria: File exports a named const 'workouts' as an ES module
Each workout has a 'name' string and a 'phases' array
Each phase has 'name', 'sets' (integer >= 1), 'restBetweenSets' (integer >= 0), and 'exercises' array
Each exercise has 'name', 'work' (integer > 0), and 'rest' (integer >= 0)
The placeholder workout 'Core Foundation' is present with warm-up (1 set), main set (3 sets, 90s inter-set rest), and cool-down (1 set)

tickets.title: Create schedule generation utility
tickets.description: Create utils.js for the core timer sub-app. The key function, createSchedule(phases), takes the phases array from a workout and expands it into a flat array of second-by-second schedule steps — one element per second of the entire workout. This is the bridge between the workout data and the Timer class. The secsToString helper can be copied verbatim from kettlebell-timer/src/utils.js.

algorithm.overview: Pre-compute a flat 'occurrences' array (one entry per exercise per set iteration across all phases and sets). Then emit schedule steps: 15s Prep, then for each phase/set/exercise emit work steps then rest steps, then after each non-final set emit inter-set rest steps.
algorithm.pre_computation: For each phase, for each set 1..phase.sets, for each exercise: push { name, phaseName, setNum, totalSets } into occurrences array. This allows O(1) lookup of the next exercise at any point.

schedule_steps.prep: 15 steps: { state: 'Prep', remainingTime: 15..1, nextExercise: 'First up: ' + occurrences[0].name }
schedule_steps.work: exercise.work steps: { state: 'work', remainingTime: exercise.work..1, exercise: exercise.name, nextExercise: <see below>, setLabel: <see below>, phase: phase.name, exerciseIndex: <global int> }
schedule_steps.rest: exercise.rest steps (skip if rest === 0): { state: 'rest', remainingTime: exercise.rest..1, nextExercise: <see below>, setLabel: <see below>, phase: phase.name, exerciseIndex: <global int> }
schedule_steps.set_rest: phase.restBetweenSets steps (only between sets, not after final set): { state: 'set-rest', remainingTime: restBetweenSets..1, nextExercise: 'Set N+1 of M coming up', phase: phase.name }

algorithm.next_exercise_text: For an exercise that is the last in its set AND not the last set: nextExercise = 'Set N+1 of M coming up'. Otherwise: nextExercise = occurrences[exerciseIndex+1].name, or null if it is the final exercise of the workout.
algorithm.set_label: null when phase.sets === 1 (to avoid cluttering single-set phases). 'Set N of M' when phase.sets > 1. Not present on set-rest or Prep steps.
algorithm.exercise_index: A global integer starting at 0, incremented once per exercise occurrence (i.e. once per exercise per set, across all phases). Never incremented during set-rest steps.

acceptance_criteria: createSchedule(phases) returns an array
First 15 elements have state 'Prep' with remainingTime counting down from 15 to 1
Work steps have state 'work', correct exercise name, exerciseIndex, setLabel (null for single-set phases)
Rest steps have state 'rest' with correct nextExercise text
The last exercise of a non-final set has nextExercise = 'Set N+1 of M coming up' on its rest steps
Set-rest steps have state 'set-rest' and no exerciseIndex field
Set-rest steps are emitted after each non-final set only when restBetweenSets > 0
Total schedule length matches: 15 + sum over phases of (sets * sum_of_exercise_(work+rest) + (sets-1) * restBetweenSets)
secsToString correctly formats seconds into M:SS and H:MM:SS

tickets.title: Create timer class
tickets.description: Create the Timer class for the core timer sub-app, adapted from kettlebell-timer/src/timer.js. The class drives the second-by-second countdown, updates DOM elements, plays audio beeps, manages the Screen Wake Lock, and handles pause/resume. The key adaptation is: remove all kettlebell-specific fields (targetReps, weight, nextReps, nextWeight), add a set-label display element, and handle state-conditional display logic for the 'set-rest' state.
changes_from_reference: Remove this.targetRepsElement and this.nextExerciseElement from constructor
Remove all targetReps, weight, nextReps, nextWeight display logic from start() interval
State label: map 'set-rest' to 'SET REST' explicitly; otherwise use step.state.toUpperCase()
Exercise display: during 'work' show step.exercise; during 'rest' show 'Next: ' + step.nextExercise (or empty); during 'set-rest' and 'Prep' show step.nextExercise
Set label: show step.setLabel when state is 'work' or 'rest' AND step.setLabel is not null; otherwise set innerHTML to empty string
unchanged_from_reference: updateProgress(exerciseIndex) method — marks li items as completed/current/upcoming
initializeAudio() — plays and immediately pauses to unlock audio on mobile
playBeep() — resets currentTime and calls play()

tickets.title: Create timer page render script
tickets.description: Create timer-render.js, the page bootstrap script for the core timer page. It reads the workout index from the query string, populates the workout name, builds the sidebar exercise list, calculates and displays the total duration, and instantiates the Timer. The sidebar must show all exercise occurrences including repetitions across sets, grouped by phase. Adapted from kettlebell-timer/src/timer-render.js.
changes_from_reference: Sidebar construction: iterate phases, then sets 1..phase.sets, then exercises — each occurrence gets a sequential id='exercise-N' li element
Sidebar label: include set number when phase.sets > 1, e.g. 'Plank (Set 1/3)'
Duration calculation: sum over phases of (sets * perSetDuration + (sets-1) * restBetweenSets), plus 15s for Prep

sidebar_construction.structure: For each phase: create section.phase-section with h2 phase name, then ul containing one li per exercise occurrence (iterating sets 1..N then exercises within each set)
sidebar_construction.li_id: exercise-{globalExerciseIndex} where index increments once per occurrence
sidebar_construction.li_content: {exercise.name} (Set N/M) — set suffix only when phase.sets > 1

tickets.duration_formula: 15 + phases.reduce((total, phase) => total + phase.sets * phase.exercises.reduce((s, ex) => s + ex.work + ex.rest, 0) + (phase.sets - 1) * phase.restBetweenSets, 0)
acceptance_criteria: Workout name is rendered in #workout-name
